title: eat shit & die 195
author: bpatrick
body: Some Onan (kind of). I thought we were due. I’m pretty happy with the way it turned out. In fact, I kind of like this version better. Hhmm.

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.text: The endings to the Onan strips are always awesome. After reading the first 2 panels I was like “wtf?” then I re-read the title panel. Excellent.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: I kind of noticed right away when I saw Sixty-9’s counterpart and heard Ms. Swan’s voice saying “it look like a man”. Still left wondering what is going on in Onan/anana’s universe and that sense of wonder is amazing. Wonder if they are ever going to meet, or if Onan was just left out in space too long and is hallucinating this.

comments.author: Erick
comments.text: I love the way tisha talks. (thats the lightbulb dude right?) And this strip was just so amazing in so many ways I don’t even know what to do with myself

comments.author: Erick
comments.text: Oh, and Onan/a really needs its own section. I love ES&D but sometimes I just want to read all the Onans

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text:
Maybe this is evidence of gender bias/discrimination . . . but I must say that sixty-9’s outfit looks creepy on a guy.

– bob

comments.author: AJ
comments.text: is Onan supposed to have sexually imagery in it or is it my disposition

comments.author: dudeth
comments.text: hahaha! the build up to the last panel is just pure genius! and so is sixty-9’s counterpart! would you ever consider making onan and onana separate ongoing stories? and have them eventually cross paths?

comments.author: DarkCanuck
comments.text: Beautiful! Not quite as subtle as the purple-head monster reference in the last Onan but still hilarious!

comments.author: Leo
comments.text: Marvelous! That last panel was particularly good.

comments.author: SoldierMD
comments.text: “If just one gets through, we’re fucked.” So true, so true…

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Thanks, guys! AJ, I think there’s probably more deliberate sexual imagery in Onans than most people even notice although a lot of it here is pretty overt.

comments.author: iaoth
comments.text: Oh no! This is the latest strip?! But I only discovered the ESaD archive earlier today!

comments.author: AJ
comments.text:
i was completely oblivious to it in reading the first few Onans maybe thats why i never got into them
only really noticed when someone pointed out purple-headed monster in the last one
i love the fact that we can discuss work with the artist, where else can you do that?
